summary: Phase 3 testing: 14/14 backend pytest cases PASS (settings public/admin/patch, checkout success w/ unit→HOLD, empty-cart 400, inactive-method 400, admin forbidden 403, reservasi (second customer blocked at cart-add), /orders/mine, cross-customer 404, upload bukti, admin list + filter, verifikasi-bayar accept (DIPROSES+DITERIMA+unit TERJUAL), reject (DIBATALKAN+DITOLAK+unit TERSEDIA), pelanggan batal, resi update → DIKIRIM, DITERIMA → SELESAI, role gating). Frontend: WhatsApp float visible on home with correct wa.me/628123456789 href; customer registration → /akun; address add via /akun; add-to-cart; /keranjang 'Lanjut ke Checkout' nav; /checkout page renders ship/pay radio from settings publik; place order creates ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX, redirects to /pesanan/{id} showing instruksi transfer + Rp total; admin /admin/pesanan list contains order; admin detail page renders. Settings UI: WA number save + Simpan works (verified via public API). CRITICAL BUG: Pelanggan cannot upload bukti bayar — frontend posts to /api/uploads/image which require_roles(OWNER,ADMIN,STAF) → 403 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi'. This blocks the full UI flow (Terima/Tolak buttons only render when order.bukti_bayar_url exists, so admin verifikasi + pengiriman form cannot be reached via UI without manually hitting /api/orders/{id}/bukti-bayar). Backend verifikasi/resi endpoints themselves are correct (proven by pytest test_full_lifecycle).

critical.issue: Role-gated to OWNER/ADMIN/STAF only — pelanggan cannot upload bukti bayar from UI (frontend calls this exact endpoint from PesananDetailPage.jsx:35). Fix: allow pelanggan to upload too, OR move bukti upload to a dedicated endpoint under /api/orders/{id}/bukti-bayar/upload that both role-checks and stores file.

minor.issue: Sets status_pembayaran=DITOLAK even when pelanggan cancels (not admin rejection). Semantics suggest 'DIBATALKAN' pembayaran state would be more accurate, but DITOLAK is acceptable.
whatsapp_pesan_default default string differs from DEFAULT_SETTINGS seed ('…tentang produk di Toko HP' vs model default '…tentang produk.'). Minor inconsistency, no functional impact.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Upload Bukti Transfer returns 403 ('Hak akses tidak mencukupi') because api.post('/uploads/image') requires staff role. Entire payment-verification flow depends on this.

integration_issues.flow: Pelanggan upload bukti → admin verify → admin resi
integration_issues.issue: Admin Terima/Tolak buttons gated by order.bukti_bayar_url. Since pelanggan can't upload (bug above), admin cannot verify from UI; and pengiriman form is gated by canShip (status DIPROSES/DIKIRIM) which requires verify first.

issues: Labels not linked to inputs via htmlFor/id — accessibility: get_by_label fails, screen readers may not associate labels. Use <Label htmlFor="nama_penerima"> + <Input id="nama_penerima">.

action_items: CRITICAL: Allow pelanggan to upload bukti image. Either (a) relax /api/uploads/image role to also accept ROLE_PELANGGAN (with size/mime safeguards), or (b) add POST /api/orders/{id}/bukti-bayar/file that accepts multipart from pelanggan and sets bukti_bayar_url in one call.

After fix, re-run UI flow: upload image → MENUNGGU_VERIFIKASI → owner /admin/pesanan/{id} shows Terima/Tolak → click Terima → DIPROSES + Pengiriman form appears → fill RESI + status DIKIRIM → status DIKIRIM.
(Optional UX) In AkunPage, link <Label htmlFor> to <Input id> for all form fields for accessibility and testability.
(Optional) Normalise whatsapp_pesan_default between models.py default and routes_settings DEFAULT_SETTINGS to a single constant.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_orders.checkout rollback: the try/except catches all exceptions including HTTPException raised inside the loop AFTER some units were reserved - good. But rolled-back units lose their new history_status 'HOLD' push (push already executed by $set+$push atomically); on rollback you set status to TERSEDIA but history still shows HOLD then TERSEDIA. Harmless but inflates history.
routes_orders.batal_pesanan always writes status_pembayaran=DITOLAK even for self-cancellation (status could stay BELUM_BAYAR / set CANCELLED).

routes_orders.update_resi exclude_unset filter: payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) only works correctly if client omits unset fields. UI sends empty strings — those pass through and overwrite nomor_resi with ''. Consider filtering empty strings too.

routes_settings._load auto-inserts DEFAULT_SETTINGS on first call — races between two first-call requests could insert twice if no unique index key; mitigated by unique index on 'id' created at startup. OK.
No background job to expire HOLD when hold_batas < now. 30-minute reservation will stay HOLD forever if customer abandons; stock permanently blocked. Needs cron/scheduler in later phase.

OrderAdminDetailPage: Terima/Tolak buttons only render when bukti_bayar_url exists; backend accepts verify from MENUNGGU_BAYAR too — frontend prevents admin from accepting without proof (reasonable), but combined with the upload bug makes the whole flow unreachable.
No role check in frontend ProtectedRoute for /pesanan or /checkout aside from redirect; backend enforces it (good).

success_rate.frontend: ~70% — WhatsApp float, register, address, cart, checkout, order creation, admin list/detail, settings-identity save all verified; bukti-upload + admin verify + resi UI flow blocked by upload role bug
